questions_and_answers.question_text: What does tóngjū almost always imply?
Why do speakers sometimes prefer nánnǚ tóngjū?
What kind of news is xīnwén, and what is it NOT?
What is the word for news between people?
What does the verb suàn mean literally?
Write the Chinese for "Forget it, don't ask him about it any more."

answers.answer_text: Suàn le, bú yào zài wèn ta le.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Did you see the television news?"

answers.answer_text: Nǐ kàn diànshì xīnwén le ma?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Give three English renderings of the idiom suàn le.

answers.answer_text: Any three of: "let it be," "let it pass," "drop the matter," "let it go at that."

questions_and_answers.question_text: What is jū a literary word for?
Write the Chinese for "If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to go, then forget it."

answers.answer_text: Nǐ yào qù jiù qù, bú qù jiù suàn le.

articles.text:
5. A: Nǐ kàn, zhèr yǒu yìpiān       Look, here's a news article on
      guānyú tóngjūde xīnwén.        "living together."
   B: Suàn le ba. Zhèizhǒng xīnwén  Forget it. What's interesting about
      yǒu shénme yìsi?               that kind of news?

Notes on No. 5

tóngjū: "to live together, to cohabit." Jū is a literary word for "to live." Although some dictionaries define tóngjū simply as "to live together," tóngjū ALMOST ALWAYS IMPLIES SEXUAL RELATIONS. It may even be used to describe romances of shorter durations. You'll notice that in some dialogues in this unit, the speakers prefer the phrase nánnǚ tóngjū in order to be explicit.

xīnwén: "news." This is the word for "news" as in "the evening news," "the news in the paper today," "official news." It is NOT the word for news between friends. (The word for news between people is xiāoxi, "tidings.")

Nǐ kàn diànshì xīnwén le ma?     Did you see the television news?
Zhè zhēn shi ge dà xīnwén.       Boy, that really is big news.

suàn le: "Forget it." Suàn is the verb "to calculate, to figure." The idiom suàn le is translated as "let it be," "let it pass," "drop the matter," "let it go at that."

Suàn le, bú yào zài wèn ta le.   Forget it, don't ask him about it
                                 any more.
Dōu gěi ni, suàn le.             Go ahead and take them all.
Nǐ yào qù jiù qù, bú qù jiù      If you want to go, then go. If you
suàn le.                         don't want to go, then forget it.
